introduction.purpose: This Error Catalogue documents validation and business errors derived from the FRD and the underlying BRD.
introduction.scope: Each error traces to a functional requirement and, through it, to a business requirement. Exact error codes and messages are treated as unresolved because the source material leaves them open (OQ-012).
audience: Human reviewers and approvers of functional requirements

errors.title: Onboarding cannot be completed
errors.description: A customer is unable to complete the onboarding journey.
errors.condition: Onboarding cannot be completed or accepted by the system.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to the customer.
errors.notes: Exact error codes/messages are unresolved (see OQ-012); exact onboarding workflow and validation rules are unresolved (see OQ-005).

errors.title: KYC information cannot be accepted
errors.description: KYC information provided by a customer cannot be accepted.
errors.condition: KYC information cannot be accepted or recorded.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to the customer.
errors.notes: Exact validation constraints and error text are unresolved (see OQ-012, OQ-013).

errors.title: Aadhaar/PAN information fails format validation
errors.description: Aadhaar/PAN information provided by a customer does not conform to the expected format.
errors.condition: Aadhaar/PAN information fails format-only, mocked validation.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to the customer.
errors.notes: Format is format-only and mocked (CON-003). Exact format rules and error text are unresolved (see OQ-012, OQ-013).

errors.title: Account activation cannot be performed
errors.description: A customer account cannot be activated.
errors.condition: Account activation fails or is not permitted.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to the requesting user.
errors.notes: Exact account-state rules and error text are unresolved (see OQ-006, OQ-012).

errors.title: Customer login fails
errors.condition: Customer login fails, including invalid credentials or unauthorized access.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to the customer.
errors.notes: Exact authentication and authorization rules and error text are unresolved (see OQ-009, OQ-010, OQ-012).

errors.title: Transfer of simulated money cannot be completed
errors.description: A customer cannot complete a transfer of simulated money.
errors.condition: A simulated transfer cannot be completed (for example, blocked by account state or unresolved limits).
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to the customer.
errors.notes: Exact transfer/payment rules and limits are unresolved (see OQ-007, OQ-012). Minimum balance and daily caps are open (see OQ-002, OQ-003).

errors.title: Receipt of simulated money cannot be recorded
errors.description: Incoming simulated money cannot be recorded for a customer.
errors.condition: A simulated receipt cannot be recorded.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error.
errors.notes: Exact transfer/payment rules and error text are unresolved (see OQ-007, OQ-012).

errors.title: Statement cannot be presented or downloaded
errors.description: A customer cannot view or download a statement.
errors.condition: A statement cannot be presented or downloaded.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to the customer.
errors.notes: Statement content/download behaviour is unresolved (see OQ-008); error text is unresolved (see OQ-012). Relates to FR-010 for download behaviour.

errors.title: KYC review or status update fails
errors.description: Bank operations cannot review KYC or set KYC status.
errors.condition: KYC review fails or a KYC status update cannot be recorded.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to bank operations.
errors.notes: See also FR-011 for KYC review. Exact status values and error text are unresolved (see OQ-012, OQ-013).

errors.title: Account activation or freeze fails
errors.description: Bank operations cannot activate or freeze a customer account.
errors.condition: An account activation or freeze cannot be performed.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to bank operations.
errors.notes: See also FR-014 for account freeze. Exact account-state rules and error text are unresolved (see OQ-006, OQ-012).

errors.title: Customer account state cannot be viewed
errors.description: Bank operations cannot view a customer account's state.
errors.condition: Account state cannot be presented to bank operations.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to bank operations.
errors.notes: Exact error text is unresolved (see OQ-012).

errors.title: Audit trail access fails
errors.description: Bank operations cannot access the audit trail.
errors.condition: The audit trail cannot be accessed or returned.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to bank operations.
errors.notes: Exact audit events are unresolved (see OQ-011); error text is unresolved (see OQ-012).

errors.title: Bank-operations login fails
errors.condition: Bank-operations login fails, including invalid credentials or unauthorized access.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error to bank operations.
errors.notes: Exact authentication and authorization rules and error text are unresolved (see OQ-009, OQ-010, OQ-012).

errors.title: Action not permitted by role
errors.description: A user attempts an action that is not permitted for their role.
errors.condition: A user requests an action inconsistent with their role's permissions.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall deny the action and surface a relevant error.
errors.notes: Exact role permissions and authorization rules are unresolved (see OQ-009); error text is unresolved (see OQ-012).

errors.title: State change cannot be recorded for audit
errors.description: A state change cannot be recorded as an auditable event.
errors.condition: An auditable state change cannot be recorded.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error and preserve auditable state-change behaviour.
errors.notes: Exact audit events are unresolved (see OQ-011); error text is unresolved (see OQ-012).

errors.title: Logout cannot be completed
errors.description: A customer or bank-operations user cannot log out.
errors.condition: Session termination cannot be completed for a customer or bank-operations user.
errors.expected_behavior: The system shall surface a relevant error.
errors.notes: Applies to FR-006 (customer) and FR-018 (bank operations). Exact error text is unresolved (see OQ-012).

consistency_notes: The BRD business-rule artifact and the BRD document both use the ID prefix BR- for business rules (BR-001..BR-008), which is distinct from but identical-in-prefix to the business-requirement IDs (BR-001..BR-023). The convention is preserved verbatim from the approved source; no rewrite was made.
All open questions OQ-001 through OQ-013 are carried forward from the BRD; none were silently resolved.

ERR-016 intentionally traces to FR-006 (source BR-006, customer logout), which is noted because it also covers FR-018 (bank-operations logout). This is an explicit consistency note, not an invented requirement.
No missing FR references were detected in the approved source material.
